But ollama is installed — and there's `.lmstudio`, `open-webui`. So "local model" = probably a small model via Ollama. GTX 260 can't run modern LLMs (no fp16 support well... actually GTX 260 has poor FP16, and Ollama requires AVX + newer compute capability; sm_11 won't be supported by modern llama.cpp which requires sm_50+ ... actually llama.cpp supports compute capability 5.0+ for CUDA builds, older dropped). So local model likely runs on CPU with 63.8 GB RAM. That's fine for a 3B-7B quantized model on CPU, and QLoRA training on CPU is painfully slow... Hmm.
